title: Question props
description: A question: its text, optional header chip, options, multiSelect, and allowOther, which offers the "Other…" row (FR-3). An option is its label, unique within the question, an optional description, preview and annotation, each plain text, and recommended, which at most one option of a question sets (proposal, open question 9); the contract's validation function checks the uniqueness rules. A question's widget items (props.items) stay refused until the widget follow-up widens the input format.
